Package net.sf.jguiraffe.di.impl

Klasse AbstractInvocationTest

java.lang.Object
net.sf.jguiraffe.di.impl.AbstractInvocationTest
Bekannte direkte Unterklassen:
TestConstructorInvocation, TestMethodInvocation
public abstract class AbstractInvocationTest extends Object
An abstract base class for testing Invocation objects. This class defines some tests for the basic functionality provided by the Invocation base class. These tests are run on concrete implementations. Some useful constants are also provided.
Version:
$Id: AbstractInvocationTest.java 207 2012-02-09 07:30:13Z oheger $

      protected DependencyProvider setUpDependencyProvider(Dependency[] parameters, boolean replay)
      Creates a mock object for the dependency provider and initializes it for the given parameter dependencies. The mock object is initialized to expect calls for querying the values of the dependencies and to return the invocation helper.

      parameters - an array with the parameter dependencies
      replay - a flag whether the provider mock should be replayed
